steps.step: Gland plate, heater stack, rod and its welded end down out of the bore together (the gland plate rides on the rod)
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, -260); tightest gap 0.1 mm to Build module S25: spigot, flange, honed 316L cylin

steps.step: On the bench: the two rod set screws out of the head, the rod (with its welded end, connector and striker) pulled down out of the head's socket and through the gland plate; the two 2-114s then come out of their grooves. The rod's top end is a plain Ø15.875 tube end in the gland's Ø15.93 throat
Heaters and thermocouples slide down out of the block once the head is off (3 stack screws); their leads run down the rod to the hermetic connector in the rod end
